title: AMA-0.5 pre-freeze cost-floor probe manifest
description: Immutable selection record for the pre-freeze cost-floor probe of docs/architecture/api-migration-direction.md §10.2. Committing a document conforming to this schema IS the selection act: the git commit that adds it binds the selection, per rule 4 of docs/evidence-and-decision-discipline.md. The manifest therefore carries no field for its own commit hash — a self-referential field cannot be filled without changing the object it claims to identify. After that commit the manifest is never edited; a legitimate reserve activation is recorded in the measurement records, not by mutating this file.

protocol_commit.description: Commit of PhysShell/007 whose docs/architecture/api-migration-direction.md governs this probe. Binds the selection to a specific revision of the protocol, so a later protocol change makes this probe's claims STALE rather than silently reinterpreted.

maintainer_budget_minutes.description: Total active maintainer minutes for the four PRIMARY cases (§10.2: 12 hours). Reserve activations do not draw on this budget.

per_case_censor_minutes.description: Hard censor per case (§10.2: 3 hours of active maintainer time). On reaching it the case outcome is written before any further work — the censor is enforced on the timer, not on judgement.

reserve_activation_budget_minutes.description: Ceiling on active maintainer minutes for reserve activations, drawn from the AMA-0.5 package remainder (§10.4), not from maintainer_budget_minutes — four primaries censoring consume the 720-minute budget exactly, so reserves would otherwise be unfunded. Two activations at the same 180-minute censor are fully funded, with no mid-experiment 'give this one a bit longer'. This is a ceiling, not six hours already spent: only minutes actually used count against the 48-hour package cap, and the remainder stays with the package.

max_reserve_activations.description: Upper bound on reserve activations across the whole probe. One validity defect is ordinary sampling noise; a second is still recoverable, which is what pre-designated reserves are for; a third means the selection failed systemically, and continuing to swap cases would be resampling against observed results wearing an innocent expression. A third validity exclusion therefore leaves the probe incomplete, restricting outcomes to NARROW or STOP (§10.2).

cases.description: Exactly four cost-driver strata, each with one primary and one reserve, all designated before any work starts. Strata are NOT claim cells — no codebook exists yet (§10.2).

stratum.description: Expected cost driver. The four strata differ deliberately, to force heterogeneity rather than to sample a population.

reserve.description: Run ONLY on a validity exclusion of the primary (blinding cannot be attested, no provider-side artifact exists). A cost-adjacent exclusion counts as CENSORED and confers no right to reach for an easier case (§10.2).

case_id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the manifest.

repository.description: Consumer repository the localization task is posed over.

commit.description: Pinned consumer-repository commit. Immutable: a moving ref would make the measured cost unattributable.

provider_artifacts.description: Provider-side artifacts the blind normalizer is permitted to read (§4). Pinned by digest, not by a link to living documentation — a URL alone points at a page that may be rewritten tomorrow.

identity.description: What the artifact is: changelog entry, spec diff, release note, migration guide.

retrieved_from.description: Where the pinned copy came from. Provenance, not the binding.

representation.description: Which serialization was pinned. A docs site may serve an unstable HTML shell and a stable markdown variant of the same page; pin the stable one.

digest.description: Digest of the retrieved bytes. This is the binding.

digest_stability_verified.description: The artifact was fetched at least twice and produced identical bytes. Verified empirically as necessary: the HTML representation of a Stripe changelog page yielded a different digest on two consecutive fetches (build nonces), which would report STALE on every re-check and make the binding worthless.

notes.description: Selection rationale. Written before any work; never amended afterwards.
